ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels account for approximately 90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated at the distal tips accounting for approximately 10%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous mottled blobs are localized at the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe tip features a localized light-grey mottled region. The right lobe tip features a larger, more distinct irregular white/light-grey patch. The central and proximal regions are uniform low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 105-degree V-shaped central depression with a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:8 relative to the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (small peaks and valleys) are visible along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge, increasing in visible amplitude toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a convex sweep trailing toward the posterior; the trailing edges follow a generally concave curve from the tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel groupings are present within the light-pigmented patches on both the left and right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct depigmentation and irregular scarring concentrated specifically at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
